_note: Curated from pylint-odoo v1.x for Odoo v9. Inherits v8 rules. Additions: @api.one deprecated (verified: `.. deprecated:: 9.0` marker on odoo.api.one at v9). v9 ships __openerp__.py only (0 __manifest__.py files found in addons/) - dual-manifest support (MANIFEST_NAMES = ('__manifest__.py', '__openerp__.py')) starts at v10, not v9. website/portal class checks.

rules.message: Manifest file is missing required key `name`.
Manifest file is missing required key `version`.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'translation-field': Translation method _("string") in fields is not necessary.
rules.message: Manifest file is missing recommended key `author`.
Manifest file is missing recommended key `license`.
Manifest file `installable` key should be a boolean.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'missing-return': Missing `return` (`super` is used) in method %s.
rules.message: Use of deprecated `_columns` dict; prefer `fields.*` class attributes.
rules.fix_template: Replace `_columns = {'field': fields.Char(...)}` with class attribute `field = fields.Char(...)`.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'renamed-field-parameter': Field parameter "%s" is no longer supported. Use "%s" instead.
rules.message: Use of deprecated `_constraints` list; use `@api.constrains` decorator.
Method uses old API `(cr, uid, ids, context)` signature; prefer new API `(self)`.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'attribute-string-redundant': The attribute string is redundant. String parameter equal to name of variable.
rules.message: `@api.one` is deprecated in v9 — avoid; use `@api.multi` with self-iteration.
rules.fix_template: Replace `@api.one` with `@api.multi` and iterate `for rec in self:` inside the method.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'translation-positional-used': Translation method _(%s) is using positional string printf formatting with multiple arguments.
rules.message: ir.model.access entry missing from security CSV — model may be inaccessible.
rules.fix_template: Ensure `security/ir.model.access.csv` lists all models defined in the module.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'context-overridden': Context overridden using dict. Better using kwargs `with_context(**%s)`.
rules.message: XML id reference does not match any declared id in the module or its dependencies.
rules.fix_template: Verify the `ref='module.xml_id'` attribute points to a valid record id.

rules.message: Translation string uses positional `%s` formatting — use named `%(name)s` for clarity.
File declared in manifest `data` list does not exist.
Demo data file declared in manifest `demo` list does not exist.
SQL injection risk: `cr.execute` called with string interpolation instead of parameterized query.
Built-in expression evaluator used with external input — use `safe_eval()` from `openerp.tools` instead.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'odoo-addons-relative-import': Same Odoo module absolute import. You should use relative import with "." instead.
rules.message: Hardcoded database ID used in code — use `env.ref()` instead.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'deprecated-odoo-model-method': %s has been deprecated by Odoo. Please look for alternatives.
rules.message: `_rec_name` field not present in model fields.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'prefer-env-translation': Better using self.env._ (see odoo/odoo#174844).
rules.message: `copy()` override does not call `super()` — may break duplication chain.
rules.fix_template: Ensure `res = super(MyModel, self).copy(default)` is called first.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'manifest-external-assets': Asset %s should be distributed with module's source code.
rules.message: `write()` override does not call `super()` — changes may not be persisted.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'no-search-all': Using an empty domain %s([]) without a `limit` will load all records, may impact performance.
rules.message: `create()` override does not call `super()` — record will not be created.
